[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Range Sum Query 2D – Mutable** [LC 308 · Range Sum Query 2D - Mutable](https://leetcode.com/problems/range-sum-query-2d-mutable/){difficulty="Hard"}

The static 2D prefix table (LC 304) answers `sumRegion` in $O(1)$ but costs $O(mn)$ to rebuild after any `update`. Block one axis — the **rows** — into strips of $B=\sqrt{m}$. For each row-strip keep a column-prefix of the strip's column sums, so "sum of rows $[bB, bB{+}B)$ and columns $[c_1,c_2]$" is one $O(1)$ subtraction. A query adds whole strips by their strip-prefix and the $\le 2B$ leftover rows by their own row-prefix — $O(m/B + B) = O(\sqrt m)$. An `update` rebuilds exactly one strip and one row's prefix. This is @sec-sqrt-a1's walk with the blocks laid along the row axis and the "summary" promoted from a single number to a column-prefix array.

[Solved in full in @sec-sqrt-p1-mutable2d.]{.card-link}
